meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 装上后,项目会加入 Discord 机器人频道:自动复制、注册 Discord 适配器,装好固定版本的依赖并跑构建与测试;同时引导你在 Discord 开发者平台建机器人、填 Token,完成后即可经机器人收发私信与服务器消息。
howto.when: 在 /setup 配置渠道或你明确要求把 Discord 机器人接入 NanoClaw 时调用;若中途离开,回到流程后会从断点继续完成添加。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 开始复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试。

say.text: 继续配置 Discord,Token 我已经填好了
say.note: 跳过凭据步骤,继续重启并验证频道。

say.text: Discord 机器人创建好了,接着走
say.note: 校验 Token 并完成剩余配置。

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot support to the project: copies and registers the Discord adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds and runs one test, then guides you through creating the bot, storing its token, restarting, and resolving the DM channel.
howto.when_en: Triggered during /setup when adding channels, or when you ask to connect a Discord bot; if you return mid-setup it resumes the remaining channel steps.

say_en.text: Add the Discord channel integration for me.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, runs tests.

say_en.text: Resume the Discord setup — I already stored the token.
say_en.note: Continues from saved credentials and restarts the service.

say_en.text: The Discord bot is created, keep going.
say_en.note: Validates the token and finishes configuration.
